units.spine: The road is open, the market is held, and nothing in the town is being built or sold off.

units.poolKey: INCOME MIX: one source carries the town
units.spine: Most of what Hochhausen earns comes from one trade, and everything else together does not come near it.

units.poolKey: TRADE PROFILE: exports and imports both present
units.spine: Goods made here and goods brought in sit on the same stalls, and a stranger is left to tell them apart.
The yards are full of goods bound out, no two lots the same. Selling out of the town is settled work.
The town eats, and food is not a subject anyone here raises unprompted.
The Cartographer's guild keeps its building and its craft, and the supply it works from has stalled.
